requirement: The simulation shall reproduce the analytic no-drag projectile range within 2% tolerance.
rationale: Validates core RK4 integration against a known closed-form solution.

requirement: The simulation shall produce a shorter range under nonzero drag than under zero drag for identical launch conditions.
rationale: Confirms drag force reduces range as physically expected.

requirement: The coordinate transform shall convert zero-azimuth range data entirely into the North component with zero East component.
rationale: Validates the ENU transform's directional correctness at a known reference case.

requirement: Telemetry CSV output shall include all six required columns (t_s, x_m, y_m, east_m, north_m, up_m) in the defined schema order.
rationale: Ensures downstream analysis tools receive a consistent, documented schema.

requirement: An abort command issued at time T with latency L shall not take effect before T+L.
rationale: Models realistic command-and-control latency between ground and vehicle.

requirement: Air density computed by the atmosphere model shall strictly decrease with increasing altitude within the valid ISA troposphere range.
rationale: Confirms the atmospheric model behaves physically.

requirement: The comparison pipeline shall identify the first time at which a residual exceeds a specified tolerance for at least three consecutive samples.
rationale: Prevents single-sample noise from being misreported as a sustained divergence.

requirement: The comparison pipeline shall not report divergence for a residual that exceeds tolerance for fewer than three consecutive samples.
rationale: Prevents false-positive divergence reports from transient noise.

requirement: A Monte Carlo campaign shall produce identical results when rerun with the same base seed.
rationale: Ensures campaign results are reproducible evidence, not one-off outputs.

requirement: Each run within a Monte Carlo campaign shall use a unique, independently derived random seed.
rationale: Prevents order-dependent or correlated randomness across runs.
